T-Treasurrrreeee!
W-W-Whoa?!\nWhat's goin' on?!
Ha ha ha!\nI'm so surprised to see such an idiot\ngot caught in such a simple trap!
Idiot?! Who are you talkin' about?!\nI was just blinded by shiny stuff!
That is called an idiot.
H-How insulting!!
Who are you anyway?!\nAt least tell us your name!!
Hm, okay.
I'm Tolan.
We are researching and practising magic near here.\nWe don't wanna let outsiders get involved.
We're busy dealing with the monsters coming from\nthe east of the hill. We don't have time.\nDo you understand?
We wouldn't have got in here if there had been\nanother way! If you want us to get out,\njust let us pass through here!
Huh?\nIs that how you behave after trespassing on\nsomeone's land?
Such a bad girl must be...
N-Naaaahhhh!!
Ooohhh...
O-Okay, then...\nMy bodyguard will help you defeat the monsters.\nSo, could you let us pass after that?
This person?\nDefeat monsters?
A ha ha ha!\nLooks so weak! How can you tell such a...
Hm...\nYou have strong eyes.
Alright. I'll admit your ability if you defeat it.\nI won't go easy on you!!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Tolan's Monster!!
Gyah!!
Hey!\nWhy don't you help me more gently?!
...What?!\nYou're not my bodyguard?
Um... Ah... Ha ha.\nWell, I kinda got carried away and, you know...\nHeh heh.
You're pretty skilled.\nI apologize for what I've done...
Hm?
Sure.\nYou can pass through here.
Oh, wait.
I guess my friends are dealing with monsters at\nGravel Terrace ahead.\nCan you give them a hand?
Huh, such a good-natured adventurer.\nI said you'd help them just because there were\nno other ways to convince her.
You don't really have to...
Huh! I know I know! This is why\nI always end up getting my comeuppance! Hmph!
Nothing's happened so far.\nIt kinda creeps me out tho...\nI have a feeling something is about to come up...
The area around here is already full of wild\nmonsters. They will react and attack if we're\nmaking too much noise, so let's proceed quietly...
Holy shhh! S-s-s-something really came up!!
The shadow that appeared looks familiar...The\nMasked Warrior who attacked traveling warriors in\nthe Land Under Cultivation. If I’m not mistaken...
Are you Cipiwon?
Ruzart...
You're Minotaur!
Hell no!! That's the leader of the undercover\nagents that banished me! I'm Ruzart!\nR-U-Z-A-R-T! Keep it your mind!!
How confident you are after all the malefactions\nyou committed! Aren't you ashamed of yourself?
Huh!!
What's with the hesitation?!\nWe had a pretty intense fight, remember?\nYou should have remembered it more clearly!!
Isn't it normal to only have a vague recollection\nof someone's name who got banished from the\nundercover unit after all the crimes he committed?
Grrrr!!
Nooo!! That was the monster that came out at the\nRuined Temple as soon as the Holy Gem was removed\nfrom the statue when we first met!!
I'm Ruzart, R-U-Z-A-R-T!! A former member of the\nResistle's undercover unit, the man banished by\nthe leader!! C'mon, we've met so many times!!
Oh, I didn't know there was such a thing.\nYou've done so many terrible things indeed,\nnow I fully understood why you got banished.
Grooaarr!!
How dare you pour salt in my wounds...\nA-anyway...let me destroy that wooden box!!
A-a-a-as I thought, you're after this wooden box?!
Ruzart's weapon broke the box into pieces!\nThe chocolate in the box lay scattered around...
Aarghh! Not again...
Hhahahaahahaha!!
Urggggh! Hey, finish him!!
Hey! Despite being banished,\nyou obviously didn't learn your lesson, did you?
Huh! I did this because I'm having trouble\ngetting food since I got banished!!
Huh, don't give me attitude!\nDo you even know what's in here?
Who cares! I was only told to destroy the big\nwooden box carried by the wanderers who pass here!!\nI was paid cheap. I don't care what's in there...
What on earth is this?! C-chocolate?!
What? I was paid that pittance just to destroy\nsomething like this?! Arghhhhh!!
No wonder he was banished...His acquaintance found\nout he would do anything for food...\nAs the saying goes, when it rains, it pours...
Jeez, the box was broken not once, but twice!\nWhat do we do now...
Don't worry about it...
Filecia! Why are you here?!
I was worried about a second attack after what you\nreported last time, so I came after you...\nand just as I expected...
But somehow, I've already figured out who went\nso far as to hire a mercenary to deliver chocolate\nto Sofya...
Filecia began to chant some spells\nin susurration...
Whaaaat?!
Wow...it feels like deja vu...
It was Lefina from Sofya City...
Put me down, put me down now!  You hick!!
Psssst! Keep your voice down! There are monsters\nthat react to loud noise near here! They'll come\nhere because of you, you know?
I don't care about monsters!\nJust stop making a fool of me already!\nLet me down now, huh!
Ahhh! See, I told ya!!\nFilecia, this way!!
Oh, nooo! Help meee!!
Hey! Don't follow us here!\nYou should knock it down!! Go get it!!
I said enough is enough!\nLet me down now, you hick!!
Wait what!!
She's the person who destroyed and tried to steal\nthe chocolate box...
Why?!
Yeah, it was me. But it's because this dirty hick\ntries to butter Pino up and bribe her\nwith chocolate...
She plans to get Pino's approval to let her stay\nin Sofya. A pleb in Sofya is just unacceptable...
W-w-w-wait a minute. Actually we were planning to\ntake the chocolate to the Besk's in Sofya,\nnot to Pino.
W-whaaat?! The Besk family?! W-why my house?!
Huh?
I just wanted to express my gratitude to Lefina\nwith a little gift for keeping me company\nall the time...
What?!
W-w-why would you do such a silly thing?\nI feel like an idiot now!\nW-w-well then, bye!!
Well...she did leave in a hurry, but it seems like\nshe left with as many chocolates as she could...
Fine. Since she got it, shall we head back?\nI would like to give you something in return...
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Ruzart!!
